$comment: Built on SIP — Starlight Proving Ground system scorecard. Schema: scorecard v0.1.
antiGoodhart: These numbers describe the system. Do not design to move them. A metric optimized-to is a metric retired.

caveats: R3 card favors compliance over reasoning ceiling
lanes.weakness: R3 shows capability saturated across the whole lineup (Haiku ties Opus on coding + grounding) — the only discriminator is output-constraint discipline (Fable best, Opus worst). No hard-reasoning/long-context lane yet where Opus's ceiling would show; no cross-family judge; no agentic multi-turn task.

precision@10 of 0.20 is the system's single weakest published number. No cross-session recall measured ('what shipped in v7.5.3?'). Real-embedding un-park trigger (PARKED-007) not yet fired. This lane is REVISE not because it failed but because it is under-measured relative to its importance.
100% recall on only 10 labeled queries is a small sample — the ceiling is unearned until the labeled set grows. No semantic/hybrid path measured (sqlite-vec not yet wired).

caveats: 7 todo = known coverage gaps, not failures
lanes.weakness: 7 todos are unmeasured risk dimensions (pack-runtime stubs, agent-event edge cases). Trust-contract is tested at envelope shape, not under adversarial concurrent access.

caveats: This lane CAUGHT a real orphan on this run: agents/starlight-evaluator.md was unregistered in AGENT_REGISTRY.md; the v76 coverage-symmetry test failed 14/15, was fixed (registry entry added), now 15/15.
lanes.weakness: The catch is the headline: the Proving Ground's own first run flagged its own new agent as an orphan. Working as designed — but it proves the symmetry suite is load-bearing and must never be skipped under time pressure.

caveats: arena fixtures = hand-authored traps (labeled as such)
lanes.weakness: eval-50 ground truth is token-overlap, which is softer than human relevance labels. No dataset is large enough to make any single-lane claim statistically (not just directionally) true.

system.overseer: The system is honest and self-policing — the substrate lane caught its own orphan, and every green number ships with a named weakness rather than a victory lap. The single load-bearing concern is the memory lane: precision@10 = 0.20 is the weakest published number and the most important capability (a memory system that recalls 1-in-5 is the gap between 'persistent context layer' and the aspiration). The strongest case to proceed is that nothing here is hidden: the weaknesses are named, dated, and falsifiable.
nextExperiments: Fire PARKED-007 (real embeddings) and re-measure memory precision@10 — the falsifier for the whole memory substrate thesis.
Add a cross-family judge (OpenRouter GPT-5) to the model lane and re-run R2 — removes the only standing bias caveat.
Author a cross-session recall eval ('what shipped in <version>?') — the memory gap no current lane covers.

attestation: Built on SIP — Starlight Intelligence Protocol
